title: Merge two lines in Ladder
summary: Arbitrate two feeders that share one outfeed with latch rungs: give line A priority, let one box through at a time and interlock the two blades.
scope: Tests give deterministic native POSIX host evidence on a simulated plant scene; they are not physical, hardware, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Arbitrate two requests with a priority: line A wins when both lines wait.
Interlock two outputs so they are never active together, and release the grant only when the box has cleared the merge.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/MergeLines.ld.json, keep two grant memories, GrantA and GrantB, as set and reset coils: grant line A first when both wait, grant a line only when no grant is active and the merge zone is empty, and end the grant when its box has left the zone.
stages.checkpoint: HoldA and HoldB are true unless that line has the grant, so the two blades are never open together.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, think about the merge point: both feeders carry boxes, but the outfeed fits one box at a time.
stages.checkpoint: Both blades hold the lines at first; then one blade opens at a time, line A first, and the next opens only after the box has left the zone; all six boxes leave and Done turns on.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter has no rungs, so nothing is loaded and no blade moves; load three boxes on each feeder, open one blade at a time, with line A first, never both together, and open the next only when the previous box has left the merge zone.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only the merge-lines scenario; watch the 3D view while it runs.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named merge-lines and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch which blade opens first and how the second line waits; no two boxes meet in the merge.
stages.checkpoint: All six boxes are delivered in turn, no box collides or drops, and Done is on at the end.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The ALWAYS assertion on collisions is the interlock check: a design that opened both blades could pass the delivery check and still fail it.
stages.checkpoint: It does not establish physical belt speed, sensor response, hardware timing, HIL, safety function, or certification.

hints.text: A grant is a latch: one rung sets GrantA when WaitA is TRUE, nothing is granted and the zone is empty; the rung for GrantB comes after it, so line A wins when both wait.

Remember that the zone sensor saw the box with a Seen latch, and clear both grants and Seen when Zone goes from TRUE to FALSE (a falling-edge contact on Zone); then HoldA is Active AND NOT GrantA and HoldB is Active AND NOT GrantB.

faultCases: The starter has no rungs, so nothing is loaded and no blade moves; load three boxes on each feeder, open one blade at a time, with line A first, never both together, and open the next only when the previous box has left the merge zone.
